title: Luna's riddle!
lines: Soy amarillo y salgo de día.
I'm yellow and come out in the day.

title: Amazing fact!
lines: In Spanish, upside-down ¿ and ¡ open questions and exclamations!
So you always know what's coming. Clever, right?

title: Did you know?
lines: Spanish is spoken by over 500 million people!
That's a LOT of new friends to talk to. 🌍

title: You're amazing!
lines: Sol y Luna think you're doing brilliantly.
Every word you learn is a little superpower!

title: Star moment!
lines: Take a deep breath and smile.
You're getting better every single day. ¡Vamos!
